request.system:
You classify one document from a business borrower's credit file.
Choose only from the listed type ids, or none_of_these when the document is none of them.
A document can have several types only when it plainly contains each of them (for example an acknowledgement together with a computation).
Judge by the content of the pages only.
Also rank up to three type ids that the document most resembles, best first.
request.user:
Document types:
- application_message: Sourcing message. The RM's sourcing email, WhatsApp message or notes, pasted when the application was created.
- application_form: Loan application form. The borrower's signed application for credit facilities.
- certificate_of_incorporation: Certificate of incorporation. Registrar of Companies certificate that a company is incorporated, with its CIN.
- moa_aoa: Memorandum and articles of association. The company's memorandum and articles of association, including its borrowing powers.
- board_resolution: Board resolution to borrow. Certified extract of a board resolution authorising the borrowing and the signatories.
- partnership_deed: Partnership deed. The deed constituting a partnership firm, with partners, shares and borrowing authority.
- partner_authority_letter: Partners' authority letter. Letter signed by all partners authorising the borrowing and the signatories.
- proprietorship_proof: Proprietorship declaration or proof. Sole proprietor's declaration of ownership of the business, with supporting registration.
- pan_entity: PAN of the entity. Permanent Account Number card or letter issued to the business entity.
- gst_registration_certificate: GST registration certificate. Form GST REG-06 registration certificate with the GSTIN, legal name and constitution.
- udyam_certificate: Udyam registration certificate. Udyam registration certificate with the Udyam number and MSME classification.
- kyc_pan_individual: PAN card of an individual. PAN card of a promoter, director, partner, proprietor or guarantor.
- kyc_aadhaar: Aadhaar. Aadhaar card or e-Aadhaar of an individual (only the last four digits are kept).
- kyc_passport: Passport. Indian passport of an individual.
- kyc_voter_id: Voter ID. Election commission elector's photo identity card.
- kyc_driving_licence: Driving licence. Driving licence of an individual.
- audited_financial_statements: Audited financial statements. Audited balance sheet and profit and loss account for one financial year, with the auditor's report.
- provisional_financial_statements: Provisional financial statements. Unaudited (provisional) balance sheet and profit and loss for the current or part year.
- projected_financial_statements: Projected financial statements. Projected balance sheet and profit and loss for future years.
- cma_data: CMA data. Credit Monitoring Arrangement data with assessment of working-capital requirement (MPBF).
- itr_acknowledgement: ITR acknowledgement. Income-tax return filing acknowledgement (ITR-V) for one assessment year.
- itr_computation: Computation of income. Computation of total income accompanying an income-tax return, for one assessment year.
- gstr_3b: GSTR-3B return. Monthly or quarterly GSTR-3B summary return for one tax period.
- gstr_1: GSTR-1 return. GSTR-1 statement of outward supplies for one tax period.
- partner_gst_report: GST analysis report (partner). GST analysis report from RBL's GST partner, summarising returns and turnover across periods.
- bank_statement: Bank statement. Statement of one bank account for a period, with every transaction and running balance.
- partner_bank_analysis: Bank statement analysis report (partner). Bank statement analysis report from RBL's partner, summarising accounts month by month.
- sanction_letter_other_lender: Sanction letter from another lender. Sanction letter of an existing facility with another bank or NBFC.
- existing_facilities_declaration: Declaration of existing facilities. Borrower's declaration of all existing borrowings, or a nil declaration.
- stock_statement: Stock and book-debt statement. Statement of stock and receivables as at a date, for drawing-power computation.
- debtors_creditors_ageing: Debtors and creditors ageing. Ageing of receivables and payables by party and age bucket.
- title_document: Title document. Registered sale deed, conveyance or title search report for the property offered as security.
- encumbrance_certificate: Encumbrance certificate. Certificate listing registered encumbrances on a property over a period.
- valuation_report: Valuation report. Valuer's report on the market and realisable value of the property offered as security.
- bureau_commercial: Commercial bureau report. Commercial credit bureau report on the borrowing entity.
- bureau_consumer: Consumer bureau report. Consumer credit bureau report on a promoter, director, partner, proprietor or guarantor.
- covering_letter: Covering letter. A letter forwarding documents, often listing them; not a document on the checklist.
- index_page: Index page. An index or contents page of a document bundle.
- email_printout: Email printout. A printed email; any attachments are separate documents.
- none_of_these: the document is none of the types above.
